subject: general
question: What is the feature of ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) organisation?

options.text: It deals with the practical use of space technology such as geodesy, satellite based telecommunications, etc.
It handles testing, assembly and integration of liquid propulsion control packages.
It applies remote sensing technology to manage natural resources.
It is used to launch sounding rockets.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It handles testing, assembly and integration of liquid propulsion control packages.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC)** is an integral part of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• IPRC is primarily responsible for **testing, assembly, and integration of liquid propulsion control packages**.
 
• This facility plays a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and efficiency of liquid propulsion systems used in various Indian space missions.
 
• IPRC is located at Mahendragiri in the state of Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• The complex is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure for testing different types of liquid engines and stages, which are vital components of ISRO's launch vehicles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ISRO, the space agency of the Government of India, is responsible for the nation's space research and exploration activities.
 
• Established in 1969, ISRO has made significant strides in space technology, launching numerous satellites for various applications such as communication, earth observation, and navigation.
 
• ISRO's achievements include the Chandrayaan and Mangalyaan missions, which explored the Moon and Mars, respectively.
 
• The organization is also working on future missions such as Gaganyaan, which aims to send Indian astronauts to space.
 
• ISRO's efforts contribute significantly to national development and technological advancement.
